Definition: a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing)
BiblicalUsage: 1) something piercing, hook, barb; 1a) meaning dubious; 2) coolness, cold (of snow); 3) shield, large shield, buckler; 3a) shield
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
